sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Market breadth remains narrow with only 2 of 11 sectors showing positive returns across all timeframes, anchored by Technology and Energy leadership while rate-sensitive groups deteriorate.

Technology (momentum 0.867) and Energy (momentum 0.783) continue to pace the market, holding the top two ranks year-to-date. Rotation into defensive pockets emerged over the last five sessions, with Healthcare (momentum 0.750) and Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.400) each climbing +1 spot in the rankings alongside Communication Services (+1 spot, momentum 0.600). 

Concurrently, yield-sensitive and rate-exposed groups are fading quickly. Financials, Real Estate, and Utilities each shed -1 rank spot over the past week, leaving Utilities as the single weakest sector in the market with an anemic momentum score of 0.067. 

## Strength
- Technology remains the premier leader with a 0.867 momentum score, holding the rank 2 position year-to-date.
- Energy maintains the top year-to-date rank (1) with a robust momentum score of 0.783.
- Only 2 of 11 sectors qualify as all-green across the week, month, quarter, half, and year-to-date: Technology (0.87 momentum) and Communication Services (0.60 momentum).

## Movers & Momentum
- Top 5-session gainers include Healthcare (rank 5, momentum 0.750), Consumer Defensive (rank 7, momentum 0.400), and Communication Services (rank 9, momentum 0.600), each advancing +1 spot.
- Top 5-session decliners are Financials (fell -1 spot to rank 6, momentum 0.55), Real Estate (fell -1 spot to rank 8, momentum 0.267), and Utilities (fell -1 spot to rank 10, momentum 0.067).
- Momentum laggards are anchored by Utilities (0.067), Consumer Cyclical (0.217, rank 11), and Real Estate (0.267).

## Divergences
- Industrials holds a top-tier year-to-date position at rank 4 despite sub-par momentum of 0.383, diverging from the broader upper ranks.
- Communication Services shows high timeframe divergence: it maintains all-green multi-period performance and a solid 0.600 momentum score, but lingers near the bottom of the board at year-to-date rank 9.
- Healthcare shows strong absolute momentum (0.750, third overall) but sits in the middle of the pack at year-to-date rank 5.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Healthcare groups are surging to join energy and industrials at the top, while select commodity and energy extraction groups face sharp near-term rank drops.

Market breadth remains selective, with 18 of 144 groups holding all-green status across all timeframes. Traditional leaders like Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.993, rank 2) and Marine Shipping (momentum 0.957, rank 4) maintain sustained strength, but capital is aggressively rotating into healthcare: Diagnostics & Research (+26 spots, rank 44) and Health Information Services (+19 spots, rank 39) posted the largest 5-day gains.

Conversely, extractive energy and materials are fading rapidly. Coking Coal plunged 41 spots to rank 96, Uranium fell 24 spots to rank 98, and Thermal Coal slid 12 spots to rank 73. Meanwhile, bottom-tier momentum laggards like Mortgage Finance (momentum 0.077) and Airports & Air Services (momentum 0.105) continue to offer no signs of recovery.

## Strength
- **Sustained Leadership:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.993), Marine Shipping (momentum 0.957), Consumer Electronics (momentum 0.910), and Steel (momentum 0.869) remain all-green and anchored in the top 36 across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
- **Healthcare Highs:** Diagnostics & Research (momentum 0.906) and Health Information Services (momentum 0.84) are among the 18 all-green industries, combining high momentum with sustained multi-month performance.
- **Resilient Niches:** Silver, Insurance - Reinsurance, and Software - Infrastructure continue to defend top-36 rankings across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Fastest Climbers:** Diagnostics & Research led short-term momentum, gaining +26 spots to rank 44, followed by Health Information Services (+19 spots to rank 39) and Drug Manufacturers - Specialty & Generic (+17 spots to rank 79, momentum 0.64).
- **Steepest Declines:** Coking Coal dropped -41 spots to rank 96 (momentum 0.41), Uranium declined -24 spots to rank 98 (momentum 0.24), and Business Equipment & Supplies lost -21 spots to rank 68 (momentum 0.48).
- **Bottom Laggards:** Mortgage Finance (momentum 0.077, rank 142) and Airports & Air Services (momentum 0.105, rank 140) sit at the absolute bottom of momentum rankings.

## Divergences
- **Fading Momentum:** REIT - Healthcare Facilities (momentum 0.68), Banks - Diversified (momentum 0.67), and Oil & Gas E&P (momentum 0.65) are showing early fatigue, each slipping 2 spots over the past 5 sessions despite strong baseline momentum.
- **Defensive Slips:** Utilities - Regulated Water (momentum 0.63) and Beverages - Non-Alcoholic (momentum 0.62) each fell 4 spots in the last 5 days.
- **Emerging Turnarounds:** Lower-momentum groups are breaking out in rank, led by Grocery Stores (+11 spots, momentum 0.46), Real Estate - Development (+10 spots, momentum 0.41), and Aerospace & Defense (+7 spots, momentum 0.38).

pulse.headline: Healthcare drives top gains while weak overall breadth keeps market conviction low

conviction.why: All-green breadth sits at just 12% alongside 0.69 mean agreement and 5 fading divergences.
